capabilities: : Edit mirrored content from either location
: Copy mirrored embeds from linked mentions
extras: Runs locally and does not send note contents to external services.
intentEvidence: Mirror is an Obsidian plugin for block transclusion that makes referenced content feel alive instead of static.
problem: Standard block references are static snippets that become outdated when the source content changes, and creating reusable embeds is a manual process.
summary: Mirror transforms static block references into live, editable transclusions that update across the vault, allowing for dynamic content embedding.
